introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Further Mathematics 3 (0775), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2024. Duration: two and a half hours.**

Answer ALL questions. For your guidance the approximate mark allocation for parts of each question is indicated in brackets. Mathematical formulae and tables, published by the Board, and noiseless non-programmable electronic calculators are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.

The paper contains eight questions.
enonce_intro_markdown: Three forces $\mathbf{F}_1 = (2\mathbf{i} - 3\mathbf{j} - \mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{N}$, $\mathbf{F}_2 = (8\mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j} - \mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{N}$ and $\mathbf{F}_3$ act at the points $\mathbf{r}_1$, $\mathbf{r}_2$ and $\mathbf{r}_3$ respectively, where $\mathbf{r}_1 = (-\mathbf{i} + 2\mathbf{j} - \mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{m}$, $\mathbf{r}_2 = (4\mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j} + \mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{m}$ and $\mathbf{r}_3 = (-3\mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j})\ \mathrm{m}$.
incertitudes: Question 1 : le sujet est un scan peu net ; les vecteurs ont été relus plusieurs fois et le résultat imposé G = racine de 611 est retrouvé, ce qui confirme la lecture des données.

questions.enonce_markdown: Find the moments of $\mathbf{F}_1$ and $\mathbf{F}_2$ about the origin. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The moment about the origin of a force $\mathbf{F}$ acting at the point with position vector $\mathbf{r}$ is $\mathbf{M} = \mathbf{r}\times\mathbf{F}$.

**Moment of $\mathbf{F}_1$.**

$$\mathbf{M}_1 = \mathbf{r}_1\times\mathbf{F}_1 = \begin{vmatrix}\mathbf{i}&\mathbf{j}&\mathbf{k}\\-1&2&-1\\2&-3&-1\end{vmatrix}
= \mathbf{i}\big[2(-1)-(-1)(-3)\big]-\mathbf{j}\big[(-1)(-1)-(-1)(2)\big]+\mathbf{k}\big[(-1)(-3)-2\cdot 2\big]$$

$$\mathbf{M}_1 = -5\mathbf{i}-3\mathbf{j}-\mathbf{k}\ \ \mathrm{N\,m}$$

**Moment of $\mathbf{F}_2$.**

$$\mathbf{M}_2 = \mathbf{r}_2\times\mathbf{F}_2 = \begin{vmatrix}\mathbf{i}&\mathbf{j}&\mathbf{k}\\4&-1&1\\8&-1&-1\end{vmatrix}
= \mathbf{i}\big[(-1)(-1)-(1)(-1)\big]-\mathbf{j}\big[4(-1)-(1)(8)\big]+\mathbf{k}\big[4(-1)-(-1)(8)\big]$$

$$\mathbf{M}_2 = 2\mathbf{i}+12\mathbf{j}+4\mathbf{k}\ \ \mathrm{N\,m}$$

questions.enonce_markdown: Given that the system is equivalent to a couple $\mathbf{G}$, find $\mathbf{F}_3$ and $\mathbf{G}$ and show that $G = \sqrt{611}\ \mathrm{N\,m}$. *[10 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Finding $\mathbf{F}_3$.** A system equivalent to a couple has zero resultant force, so $\mathbf{F}_1+\mathbf{F}_2+\mathbf{F}_3=\mathbf{0}$:

$$\mathbf{F}_3 = -(\mathbf{F}_1+\mathbf{F}_2) = -(10\mathbf{i}-4\mathbf{j}-2\mathbf{k}) = -10\mathbf{i}+4\mathbf{j}+2\mathbf{k}\ \ \mathrm{N}$$

**Finding $\mathbf{G}$.** The couple has the same moment about every point, so $\mathbf{G}$ is the sum of the moments of the three forces about the origin. First the moment of $\mathbf{F}_3$:

$$\mathbf{M}_3 = \mathbf{r}_3\times\mathbf{F}_3 = \begin{vmatrix}\mathbf{i}&\mathbf{j}&\mathbf{k}\\-3&-1&0\\-10&4&2\end{vmatrix}
= \mathbf{i}\big[(-1)(2)-0\big]-\mathbf{j}\big[(-3)(2)-0\big]+\mathbf{k}\big[(-3)(4)-(-1)(-10)\big]$$

$$\mathbf{M}_3 = -2\mathbf{i}+6\mathbf{j}-22\mathbf{k}$$

Then, using part (i),

$$\mathbf{G} = \mathbf{M}_1+\mathbf{M}_2+\mathbf{M}_3 = (-5+2-2)\mathbf{i}+(-3+12+6)\mathbf{j}+(-1+4-22)\mathbf{k} = -5\mathbf{i}+15\mathbf{j}-19\mathbf{k}\ \ \mathrm{N\,m}$$

**Magnitude.**

$$G^2 = (-5)^2+15^2+(-19)^2 = 25+225+361 = 611 \quad\Longrightarrow\quad G = \sqrt{611}\ \mathrm{N\,m}\ (\approx 24.7\ \mathrm{N\,m}).$$
